title: Windows devices are in more than one update ring

report.title: {Items.Count} Windows {Plural(Items.Count, 'device is', 'devices are')} in more than one update ring

messages.businessImpact: Which schedule a device follows is decided by policy precedence rather than by intent, so a machine meant to be in the pilot may be patching with the broad population, or the reverse.
remediation: Make the ring groups mutually exclusive, using exclusions on the broad ring for the pilot population.
